title: EDIFACT definition registry
description: What a parser and a validator need to know about one UN/EDIFACT directory (for example D.01B): data elements, composites, segments, code lists and message structures. A registry is generated at install time from the official UNECE files and never committed or shipped (ADR 7). Rules a schema cannot express, such as references that must resolve, are listed in contracts/registry/README.md.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this format. Readers refuse a version they do not know.

directory.description: Which directory this registry describes. The three parts are the ones a UNH segment carries in its message identifier (S009), which is how a message finds its registry.

syntaxVersions.description: ISO 9735 syntax versions this registry can be used with. Element repetition (maxOccurs above 1 on a segment element) only applies from syntax version 4.

source.description: Where the registry comes from, to reproduce it and to know which licence applies to it. A registry built from UNECE files must say which files, which generator and when.

archives.description: The files the registry was built from.

codeLists.description: Code lists, by identifier. A data element points to its list with codeList.

messages.description: Message structures, by message type. A registry may hold only some of the messages of its directory.

compositeTag.description: C for a composite of a message, S for a service composite, then three digits.

messageType.description: Six upper-case letters, for example ORDERS.

status.description: M: mandatory, at least one occurrence. C: conditional, may be absent. The minimum number of occurrences follows from it: 1 or 0. A mandatory component of a composite is only required where the composite is present, and a mandatory node inside a group only inside an occurrence of the group.

maxOccurs.description: Largest number of occurrences allowed. 1 when absent.

dataElement.description: A simple data element and its representation.

type.description: a: alphabetic, n: numeric, an: alphanumeric.

minLength.description: Fewest characters in a value. The decimal mark and the sign of a number do not count. Equal to maxLength for a fixed-length element (an3); 1 for a variable one (an..35).

maxLength.description: Most characters in a value. Not less than minLength.

codeList.description: Key of the code list that gives the values of this element. Absent when the element is free.

composite.description: A composite data element: an ordered list of simple data elements. The position of a component is its index in components, starting at 1.

ref.description: Tag of a simple data element.

segment.description: A segment: an ordered list of data elements. The position of an element is its index in elements, starting at 1, and a composite counts as one element.

ref.description: Tag of a simple data element or of a composite.

closed.description: True when codes holds every valid value. False when the list is maintained elsewhere (by a standards body or by a trading community): codes is then only what the directory knows, and a value outside it is not necessarily an error.

codes.description: The values of the list, by code.

message.description: The structure of a message: the segments and groups between UNH and UNT, in the order they must appear. UNH and UNT themselves are left out: the service definitions of the syntax describe them.

segmentNode.description: One segment of the message, with its status and repetition at this place of the structure.

groupNode.description: A segment group: nodes that repeat together, up to maxOccurs times. Groups may be nested.

id.description: SG followed by a number, unique in the message.

trigger.description: The segment that opens each occurrence of the group. It is mandatory and occurs once per occurrence of the group, so it has neither status nor maxOccurs.

nodes.description: What follows the trigger inside the group, in order. Absent when the group is only its trigger.

sequence.description: Position of the node in the message structure table of the directory, for example 0020. Informative.

section.description: Section of the message, set on top-level nodes. Informative.
